neighbours.label: An empty string literal in code written directly after an opening bracket, as the only argument of a call with single quotes (f('')), the only item of a list ([''] or [""]) or a dictionary key ({'': ...} or {"": ...}); it peaks on the closing quote. Quiet: empty strings after a space or = (x = '', a later argument after a comma, a comparison at the end of a line), double-quoted f(""), filled strings and prose about empty quotes.
neighbours.short: empty string right after an opening bracket

predictions: Blind test (sentences written by a label-only author). Expect most bracket-opened fire items to hold; ''.join after a space and ('', 'data') may fuse into one token and stay quiet.
